description: Land Title Settlement Department - Makuluwa, Four Gravets Galle D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination regarding specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and legal status of land titles. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
